examples.en: They have a cat. It is big.
My sister is at home now.

examples.uz: Opam dadamni yaxshi ko'radi va men ham dadamni yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.en: My sister loves my dad and I love my dad too.
I usually read in the morning.
My sister usually plays with the cat.

examples.uz: U shifokor va u har kuni ishlaydi.
examples.en: She is a doctor and she works every day.

examples.uz: U mening opam va u kitoblarni sevadi.
examples.en: She is my sister and she loves books.
The cat is happy. The cat is not happy.
The pen is on the bag.
The cat is on the table.

examples.uz: Ularga bu qizil stol kerak emas.
examples.en: They do not need this red table.

story.title: Kichik hikoya
story.text: In the morning, my sister and I eat bread at the table. She says, 'I love my cat.' The cat is on the table too and plays with my small red pen. She is happy and I am happy too. Usually we eat bread and drink water in the morning. My sister says, 'The cat needs help.' I say, 'We can go to the doctor in the afternoon.' In the afternoon, we go to the doctor. The doctor says, 'The cat is not happy.' My sister is not happy now and says, 'Thank you, doctor.' At home, she usually plays with the cat, but now I play with the cat.
